description: Use for the average ZUS pension paid now, disability and survivor pensions, and sickness allowances. For a future pension, use get_pension_forecast. Average old-age pension paid by ZUS (gross and net), disability and survivor pensions, number of pensioners, sickness and maternity allowances, the pension to wage ratio finwire_pension_wage_ratio, CPI, minimum pension and indexations, monthly from preliminary ZUS data (without KRUS and uniformed services).
